reason: My guests pay a lot for the villa and expect me, not a chatbot; I answer the same few questions myself and my 9.5 is built on that personal touch. I won't hand that to a robot just to save a few minutes a day.
objection: One wrong or cold answer in German to a guest paying €4,000 a week could cost me a tenth of a point on Booking, and that is worth far more than €35 a month.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing other high-end villa owners on this coast who used it a full season and kept or raised their Booking score, with guests mentioning it positively in reviews.
